title: Woodpeckers were the first to know
original_title: കാട് വെട്ടിയ വിവരം ആദ്യം അറിഞ്ഞത് മരംകൊത്തികളായിരുന്നു
overview: Maanish belongs to a group of tree cutters. While returning home, he accidentally lost an axe he was supposed to hold onto. Despite all his efforts, he can't recover the axe. Maanish is then approached by a bizarre creature named Maramkothy, who promises to help him retrieve the lost axe.
